pr.title: feat(cli): validate config in `navi doctor` (static checks + --offline)
pr.body:
feat(cli): validate config in `navi doctor` (static checks + --offline)

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #116
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->

seed.patch:
diff --git a/crates/navi-notifier/src/config.rs b/crates/navi-notifier/src/config.rs
index 4818401..4892e10 100644
--- a/crates/navi-notifier/src/config.rs
+++ b/crates/navi-notifier/src/config.rs
@@ -590,7 +590,7 @@ fn is_valid_repo_glob(pattern: &str) -> bool {
 fn is_hhmm(s: &str) -> bool {
     matches!(s.split_once(':'), Some((h, m))
         if h.len() == 2 && m.len() == 2
-        && h.parse::<u8>().is_ok_and(|h| h < 24)
+        && h.parse::<u8>().is_ok_and(|h| h <= 24)
         && m.parse::<u8>().is_ok_and(|m| m < 60))
 }

expected.description: is_hhmm accepts hour 24 (`h <= 24`), so doctor reports times like 24:30 as valid.
